body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It starts at E311 Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Rd.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Dubai's gone and done it again - opened another biggest and best attraction! Enter IMG Worlds of Adventure, the world’s largest indoor theme park. It boasts five action-packed zones and a lot of rides, shows, and characters from Cartoon Network and the Marvel Universe!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €68.75. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 87 ratings and 65 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
